thread:
incident_bot: :pager: ALERT: cont-batch-path p99 latency spike in us-west2 (service=redwood-inference-contbatch)
incident_bot: metrics: p95=420ms, p99=1.24s, streaming stalls +68% vs baseline. Paging oncall.
kira_sre: I’m on it, looking at the cont-batcher queue and packer metrics.
mike_runtime: seeing large packs ~25% larger than normal, mixlen skewed — a lot of multi-tenant requests with seq>1k getting packed together. kv-cache eviction spikes noted as well.
anya_ml: any recent model rollouts or config changes?
mike_runtime: no model rollouts. We pushed a packing heuristic change last night to improve throughput for dedicated pools (PR #4821).
kira_sre: correlating -> packing heuristic + mixed seq mix likely amplifying tail. Some tenants pushing long-context chat leading to big batches and head-of-line delay for streaming small seq.
sam_support: Support sees 3 active customer tickets referencing slow responses, one escalation from Customer X. Customer X latency traces show streaming stall at 800-1200ms.
luca_prod: we need a quick customer impact summary for ops-notify. Which tenants affected and % of traffic?
mike_runtime: affected tenants ~4 high-QPS tenants, combined ~18% of traffic in us-west2, 70% of long-seq requests from two tenants.
kira_sre: mitigation options (short): 1) reduce max_batch_tokens on cont-batcher from 4096 -> 2048; 2) enable seqlen-aware priority (prefer small seq for streaming); 3) flip packer back to conservative mode (rollback PR); 4) enable hedging for streaming with 150ms deadline to fallback streamer; 5) route 10% traffic to fallback model variant (smaller kv footprint).
anya_ml: priority 2 and 1 are low-risk and should reduce tail quickly. Hedging may increase cost but will reduce user-visible stalls.
mike_runtime: agree. I can flip flags via runtime-configs and restart packer pods. Command lined up: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/cont-batcher-packer` and `runtimectl set contbatch.max_batch_tokens 2048 --env=us-west2`.
kira_sre: do the flag flips and restart; I’ll monitor p95/p99 and KV eviction.
sam_support: prepping a short message for Customer X: "We're investigating elevated latency in us-west2 related to batching. Mitigations in progress, ETA 15-30m, we will update once p99 improves." Approve?
luca_prod: send that, mention we're doing traffic routing and batch tuning. Keep it non-technical.
(10m later)
mike_runtime: action: runtimectl set contbatch.max_batch_tokens=2048 -> applied, packer rolled back to conservative mode, hedging flag enabled (150ms) for streaming.
kira_sre: initial numbers after change: p95=310ms, p99=520ms, streaming stalls down ~45%. KV eviction rate halved.
anya_ml: nice — still seeing a small p99 tail ~520ms, likely residuals from in-flight mega-batches. We should keep seq-aware priority and consider per-tenant max_batch_tokens for the two heavy tenants.
mike_runtime: can add per-tenant cap, quick config: `runtimectl set tenant:tenant-42.max_tokens=1024 tenant:tenant-88.max_tokens=1024` — will apply now.
kira_sre: apply and watch.
mike_runtime: applied. dashboards: https://graf.redwood/contbatch/us-west2/quickview (shared)
sam_support: Customer X notified: "Mitigations applied; latency improving, we'll monitor and follow up." Customer acknowledged, asking for postmortem.
luca_prod: getting legal/sev process aligned; ask for timeline and root cause hypothesis for postmortem.
kira_sre: hypothesis: packing heuristic change + increased multi-tenant long-seq traffic produced pathological pack combos that amplified head-of-line latency for streaming requests. Root cause likely missing fairness in packer scheduling for mixed seq lengths.
anya_ml: recommend follow-ups: add unit/regression tests for packer fairness, add a canary for packing heuristics, implement per-tenant token caps, and improve alerting to surface seq-distribution shifts earlier.
mike_runtime: I'll put a mitigation PR for seq-aware scheduling and per-tenant caps. Quick TODOs created: #1 apply per-tenant caps (done), #2 add seq-distribution alert (ALERT-987), #3 rollback heuristic in stable branch (PR opened).
kira_sre: closing the pager unless we see re-escalation. Final metrics at last check: p95=305ms, p99=478ms, streaming stalls -52%.
sam_support: will collect affected request IDs for postmortem and customer follow-up.
luca_prod: thanks all. Please add short incident timeline in #incidents and assign postmortem owner. :thumbsup:
kira_sre: filing incident ticket now and assigning to mike_runtime for remediation follow-ups. :eyes:"
